description: Defines classes, structs, and functions related to UCI indication selection and timeout handling in a scheduler, including UCI actions, timeout notifications, and internal data structures for managing UCI grants.

classes.name: uci_action
classes.description: Represents an action to be taken upon receiving a UCI indication PDU, including type, validity, SR detection, HARQ-ACK bits, SINR, timing offset, and CSI report.

classes.name: uci_indication_timeout_notifier
classes.description: Abstract class defining an interface for timeout notifications related to UCI grants.

classes.name: uci_indication_selector
classes.description: Manages UCI grants, handles UCI indication PDUs, timeouts, and combines multiple UCI PDUs into actions.

classes.name: uci_entry
classes.description: Internal data structure representing a scheduled UCI grant awaiting feedback, including associated RNTI, UCI PDUs count, actions, and timeout info.

methods.name: uci_indication_selector
methods.description: Constructor initializing the UCI indication selector with a timeout notifier, acknowledgment timeout, and max grants per slot.

methods.name: handle_uci_ind_pdu
methods.description: Processes an incoming UCI indication PDU and updates internal state accordingly.

methods.name: handle_result
methods.description: Called on each slot to process scheduler results.

methods.name: handle_discarded_ucis
methods.description: Resets all UCI grants with pending feedback when an error is received for a slot.
